title: EMPIRES
author: Sakti Sekhar Dash
text:
We built the empire,
Mixing blood and dust
Propping the pillars of stones
With bent and broken bones.
The empire stank of sweat
In the heat of summer,
While piles of flesh lay
Rotting in barren fields.
Hands were too tired
To wave away
The bothersome flies,
Alighting on dead eyes.
The rains came bringing
The showers of blood,
Casting down the stones,
Laying bare the bones
And the blood flowed streaming,

Ribbons of red,
In the grey of the dust.
Winter came and went;
Spring found us
A pile of bones lying

In the dust with
The bent and broken bones.
We lay in the barren fields,
Watering the parched earth
With blood and sweat,
Stripping the flesh from
Our broken bones,
Leaving it to rot
In the grimy dust,
Watching the flies
Hover and settle
On our dead eyes.
stanzas: In the grey of the dust.
We lay in the barren fields,
